# Additional dependency license text

Retrieved from the SPDX license-list-data project's public license text collection on 2026-09-04:

* `CPL-1.0.txt`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/main/text/CPL-1.0.txt — ActionListWinForms 2.0.0 declares CPL-1.0 in its NuGet metadata but packages no license text.
* `GPL-3.0-only.txt`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/main/text/GPL-3.0-only.txt — included with the upstream FastColoredTextBox LGPL version 3 notice, which incorporates the GNU GPL version 3 terms.

The original vendor license files remain unchanged. Packaging copies these additional texts alongside the source and dependency notices.
